name: jobFairForm
description: JobFairForm is a responsive web application built for the University of Sharjah's job and internship fairs. It provides students and graduates with a streamlined, paperless way to submit their applications, featuring real-time validation, email confirmation, and secure data handling—fully integrated with the JobFair backend system.

paragraphs: A dedicated web application designed to simplify and digitize the application process for students and graduates attending job and internship fairs organized by the CASTO Office at the University of Sharjah. JobFairForm enables applicants to submit their personal and academic details through a clean, mobile-optimized interface, eliminating the need for paper forms and ensuring data is securely handled.
Live Preview: JobFairForm Web App Repository: GitHub - amxr21/jobFairForm

JobFairForm acts as the frontend-facing portal for applicants at career fairs. Built with a focus on simplicity, accessibility, and responsiveness, this system streamlines the data collection process while securely storing applicant information for later access by participating managers and the CASTO administration.
features: Real-time input validation with instant feedback
Responsive design optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices
Secure transmission and storage of applicant data
Confirmation email with QR code ticket sent upon successful submission
